subject.title: Scope memory dreaming sweeps by agent

question: Should OpenClaw accept `plugins.entries.memory-core.config.dreaming.agents` as the first durable per-agent Dreaming scope API, or wait for the broader per-agent Dreaming design?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but config location, fail-closed semantics, SDK exposure, and schedule/staggering scope are compatibility-sensitive product/API choices.

options.title: Close Until Sponsored
options.body: Close this PR as an unsponsored contributor implementation and keep the API decision on the canonical issue.

options.title: Sponsor Allowlist Slice
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or mark this PR for human review if `dreaming.agents` is the desired first increment and schedules are split out.

options.title: Redesign Around Per-Agent Blocks
options.body: Use the canonical issue to design an `agents.list[].dreaming` or stagger/schedule model before accepting code.

recommendation.title: Close Until Sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this PR as an unsponsored contributor implementation and keep the API decision on the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Dreaming resolver/runtime/status work makes this the strongest available routing signal for the product/API decision.
